purpose: MASTER-owned scheduling protocol that decomposes approved work into atomic execution units and dispatches the largest safe parallel wave that fits dependencies, agent capabilities, capacity, separation-of-duties rules and mutation-conflict constraints.

workDecomposition.compositeRule: A COMPOSITE work item is never dispatched directly. Planning decomposes it into ATOMIC child work items with explicit dependencies, output contracts, resource access and join policy.
workDecomposition.parentCompletion: A parent may advance beyond execution only after the configured child join predicate is satisfied and any required integration/review work is accepted.
workDecomposition.selectiveRework: Only affected child work items and downstream dependents are reopened; accepted unaffected children remain accepted.
workDecomposition.dependencyGraphRule: Scheduling dependencies must form an acyclic directed graph. Any cycle is invalid planning state and blocks READY derivation until replanned.

readinessPredicate: all dependency work items required by the join predicate are ACCEPTED
all read inputs are bound to immutable provider revisions
active execution mandate covers the work item and capabilities
at least one ACTIVE dispatch-enabled actor has all required capabilities
required reviewer independence can still be satisfied

capacityModel.projectParallelismCeiling: min(explicit maxParallelJobs when configured, otherwise total free eligible agent slots; totalFreeEligibleAgentSlots; countReadyAtomicJobs; conflictFreeSetSize)
capacityModel.freeSlotCalculation: maxConcurrentJobs minus nonterminal MASTER job states assigned to that agent
capacityModel.rule: Six registered active chat agents with capacity 1 may receive six simultaneous jobs only when at least six READY atomic jobs are mutually conflict-free and capability-compatible.

conflictModel.immutableReadRule: READ/READ and immutable READ versus WRITE may execute concurrently because the reader is pinned to an immutable revision.
writeConflictRules: Two jobs conflict when their writeSet conflictDomain values intersect.
Two jobs conflict when their exclusiveKeys intersect.
Two jobs conflict when either job has UNKNOWN or PROJECT_WIDE write conflict scope.
Two jobs targeting the same explicit work branch conflict.
conflictModel.pathRule: A conflictDomain must conservatively cover all paths that can be mutated by the job. Narrower path selectors may be used only when the Factory or planner can prove non-overlap.
conflictModel.safeDefault: Any ambiguity is treated as conflict and the jobs are serialized.

eligibility: agent has at least one free scheduling slot
agent is not prohibited by separation-of-duties rules
actual provider rights cover the proposed job
assignmentPolicy.reuseRule: Prefer already-registered eligible agents; do not create a new agent identity merely to increase parallelism without HUMAN approval.
jobMaterializationRequirements: versioned mandatory skills with immutable refs
resource snapshot and dedicated Git workspaces
assignmentPolicy.roleBindingRule: Scheduler assignment is incomplete until the canonical job explicitly binds the roleId the selected agent must assume. Persistent agent identity alone is insufficient.
assignmentPolicy.skillBindingRule: Every mandatory skill required for execution is explicitly embedded as a versioned, described, immutable-reference skill contract in the job.
assignmentPolicy.returnRouteRule: All result, HUMAN report, evidence and audit destinations are fixed before dispatch.

leaseProtocol.acquisition: All leases for a dispatch wave must be acquired using current provider revisions before any selected job is treated as successfully dispatched.
leaseProtocol.release: Release only after terminal or explicitly blocked job reconciliation and provider readback.
leaseProtocol.expiryRule: A time/heartbeat expiry never authorizes silent job reassignment. Expiry produces RECONCILE_REQUIRED until MASTER establishes whether the prior agent may still have external effects.

gitIsolation.mutatingJobRule: Every job with a non-empty writeSet receives one or more dedicated Git workspaces rooted at immutable base commits.
gitIsolation.integrationRule: Parallel contribution branches are integrated only after each job result is VERIFIED and required review/integration gates pass.
gitIsolation.branchKeyRule: jobKey and agentKey are deterministic Git-ref-safe projections of jobId and agentId using only letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen; the original IDs remain authoritative in job/result records.

fanOutFanIn.fanOut: One approved parent may expose multiple READY atomic children; MASTER may dispatch a safe subset or all of them in one wave.
fanOutFanIn.fanIn: Downstream join work becomes READY only when its declared dependency/join predicate is satisfied by ACCEPTED upstream work, never merely RESULT_SUBMITTED work.

observability.humanSummary: MASTER should present aggregate utilization and blockers without requiring the HUMAN to inspect raw JSON.
